title: CloudCalls
description: Onus Cloud's log of the calls made under a task token: the input of `onus provenance --calls FILE` and `onus ci pr --calls FILE`. Also read: the API's `{"calls": [...]}`, with `createdAt` for `at` and `credentialId` for `tokenId`.

CallDecision.description: How Onus Cloud decided a call.

oneOf.description: The API could not answer it.

CloudCall.description:
One call Onus Cloud logged under a task token: the input of `onus
provenance --calls FILE` and `onus ci pr --calls FILE`, which take a
JSON array of these.

at.description: When it was made (`createdAt` is read too).

reason.description: The denial, as it was sent back.

scope.description: What the route needs of a scoped token.

task.description: The task the token was minted for.

tokenId.description: The token's id (`credentialId` is read too); never the token.

Moment.description:
A time: Unix seconds, or an RFC 3339 date in UTC
(`2026-10-12T10:00:00Z`, `Z` or `+00:00`).
